480	Abuhatzeira.	Abuhatzeira.
481	So he took this fellow, and they traveled from Ramla to Netivot.	Então ele levou esse rapaz, e viajaram de Ramla a Netivot.
482	They reached Baba Sali, and Baba Sali came out there as usual.	Chegaram ao Baba Sali, e o Baba Sali apareceu ali, como de costume.
483	He was supremely holy, supremely holy.	Era um santo supremo, um santo supremo.
484	He sat there with his arak. Whoever walked in would see crates of arak, crates of arak he had there.	Ele sentava assim com o seu arak. Quem entrava via caixas de arak, caixas de arak que ele tinha ali.
485	He would sit with his arak and cover it, since blessing rests only on what is hidden from the eye, covering it with a towel,	Ele sentava com o seu arak e o cobria, pois a bênção só existe no que está oculto aos olhos, cobrindo-o com uma toalha,
486	and he called his son-in-law.	e chamou o seu genro.
487	He said to him, "Who brought you here?"	Disse-lhe: "Quem trouxe você aqui?"
488	He said, "I came to you because there's a fellow with us, a poor man who lacks children."	Disse: "Vim a você porque há um rapaz conosco, um coitado que não tem filhos."
489	He said, "Without children?"	Disse: "Sem filhos?"
490	"Call him here."	"Chame-o aqui."
491	He called him.	Chamou-o.
492	He said to him, "You, do you have a problem with children?"	Disse-lhe: "Você tem problema com filhos?"
493	He said, "Yes, Rabbi, maybe the Rabbi will bless me."	Disse: "Sim, Rav, talvez o Rav possa abençoar."
494	He said to him, "Wait a moment."	Disse-lhe: "Espere um momento."
495	He took out a glass for him.	Tirou um copo para ele.
496	He poured a glass of arak there.	Serviu ali um copo de arak.
497	He said to him, "Drink."	Disse-lhe: "Beba."
498	"You will have... drink."	"Você terá... beba."
499	He drank.	Ele bebeu.
500	He said to him, "Be healthy."	Disse-lhe: "Fique bem."
501	The poor man.	O coitado.
502	He staggered along until he left from there.	Cambaleou até sair dali.
503	He left.	Foi embora.
504	Ten minutes later the Rabbi came again, called his son-in-law, Rabbi David.	Dez minutos depois, o Rav veio de novo e chamou o seu genro, Rabi David.
505	"Ah, what brings you here?"	"Ah, o que o traz aqui?"
506	The Rabbi says to him, "There's a poor fellow, he has no	O Rav diz: "Há um coitado, ele não tem"
507	children." "Call him here." He called him: "You, you have no children?"	"filhos." "Chame-o aqui." Chamou-o: "Você não tem filhos?"
508	"Yes, Rabbi, I have no children." "Come here." He poured him another glass.	"Sim, Rav, não tenho filhos." "Venha aqui." Serviu-lhe mais um copo.
509	"With respect, drink." That one didn't know how to drink, he wouldn't drink, but he raised the glass and drank.	"Com todo respeito, beba." Aquele não sabia beber, não ia beber, mas levantou o copinho e bebeu.
510	Again he said to him, "Be healthy." That one almost fainted. After a few minutes	De novo disse-lhe: "Fique bem." Aquele quase desmaiou. Depois de alguns minutos,
511	again: "Rabbi David, what brings you here?"	de novo: "Rabi David, o que o traz aqui?"
512	He says to him, "A poor fellow, he has no children."	Diz-lhe: "Um coitado, ele não tem filhos."
513	He said to him, "Bring him here."	Disse-lhe: "Traga-o aqui."
514	They lifted him onto the stretcher and brought him to him.	Levantaram-no na maca e o levaram até ele.
515	He said to him, "Listen, you have no children."	Disse-lhe: "Escute, você não tem filhos."
516	"No, Rabbi, I have no children."	"Não, Rav, não tenho filhos."
517	He said to him, "Come, drink."	Disse-lhe: "Venha, beba."
518	He gave him seven like that, finished him off.	Deu-lhe sete assim, acabou com ele.
519	At the eighth glass he came to him and says to him, "Rabbi David, what	No oitavo copo ele veio a ele e disse: "Rabi David, o que"
